group_manifest.proof_strategy: Prove the pure first-occurrence equation by induction on the prefix; establish stop=nil and member split/splice facts from the recursive xizi_dllseg definition; use xizi_dll_open/xizi_dll_close and existing xizi_dllseg_unfold to expose or rebuild ownership. Then solve entail_wit_1 by the anchor disjunction, the four returns by choosing their resource-complete disjunct and normalizing dispatch/first_value/next_value, and the two contract-derivation witnesses by choosing the same abstract node list and discharging the wand with the normalized dispatch equation.

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: ~ In node prefix -> xizi_double_link_next_value (prefix ++ node :: suffix) node = xizi_double_link_first_value suffix

premises.discharged_by: PreH4/PreH5 in the generated member obligations, or the first-occurrence decomposition helper in entail_wit_1

candidate_helper_declarations.statement_shape: xizi_dllseg stop prev stop last nodes entails nodes = nil and prev = last while preserving the segment resource needed by the caller
prefix dllseg to node ** node links ** suffix dllseg from node entails one dllseg over prefix ++ node :: suffix

premises.discharged_by: PreH6/PreH7 or PreH7/PreH8 in the generated return obligations

In node nodes and xizi_dll head nodes entail node <> head while preserving xizi_dll head nodes

Then solve entail_wit_1 by the anchor disjunction, the four returns by choosing their resource-complete disjunct and normalizing dispatch/first_value/next_value, and the two contract-derivation witnesses by choosing the same abstract node list and discharging the wand with the normalized dispatch equation.
group_entry.grouping_reason: All seven obligations belong to one DoubleLinkListGetNext dispatch refinement and share the same first-occurrence, segment split/splice, and dispatch-normalization helper family. Keeping them together lets one worker prove the helper family once; the group has 7 witnesses, below the controller maximum of 12, and no cross-group dependency is needed.

per_witness_plan.proof_of_DoubleLinkListGetNext_entail_wi: Unfold anchor. Sentinel arm: open xizi_dll and choose the left existential/disjunct; dispatch reduces to first_value because node=head. Member arm: use first-occurrence member decomposition, choose the right existential/disjunct, and normalize next_value/dispatch from the prefix-not-In fact.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_DoubleLinkListGetNext_return_wi: Choose the full-resource disjunct. first=head makes the segment start at its stop, hence nodes=nil and first_value=0; close the DLL and reduce dispatch at the sentinel.
Choose the full-resource disjunct. node_next=head makes the suffix segment empty; normalize next_value at the first occurrence to 0, splice prefix/node/suffix, and close the DLL.
Choose the full-resource disjunct. node_next<>head lets xizi_dllseg_unfold expose nodes_after=node_next::l0; normalize first_value and next_value, splice the segments, and close the DLL.
Choose the full-resource disjunct. first<>head lets xizi_dllseg_unfold expose nodes=first::rest; reduce first_value/dispatch and close the DLL.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_DoubleLinkListGetNext_derive_se: Instantiate nodes_dispatch_case with nodes_sentinel_case, prove anchor by node=head, and discharge the wand by reducing dispatch at the sentinel and preserving the framed DLL.
per_witness_plan.proof_of_DoubleLinkListGetNext_derive_me: Instantiate nodes_dispatch_case with nodes_member_case, prove anchor by In, derive node<>head from DLL membership, and discharge the wand by reducing dispatch to next_value while preserving the DLL.
